t.E474.agn: No separate EFSA re-evaluation opinion on E474 was found. In its 2023 opinion on E473, EFSA cited the group ADI of 40 mg/kg body weight set in 2004 for E473 and E474.
t.E474.body: Sucrose esters are partly broken down in the gut into sucrose and fatty acids; very little is absorbed unchanged (bioavailability of sucrose monostearate in rats 0.26–0.33%).
t.E474.eval: The fatty acid source may be vegetable or animal (including beef/pork); the source is often not stated on the label.
t.E474.prod: It is an emulsifier produced by reacting sucrose with edible fats and oils.
t.E474.regx.0: Group ADI of 40 mg/kg body weight shared with E473 (2004); no separate re-evaluation opinion for E474 was found.
t.E474.summary: An emulsifier mixture produced from sugar and fats. It is used in cake and ice cream.
t.E474.what: It is an emulsifier consisting of a mixture of sucrose fatty acid esters and mono-/diglycerides; it allows oil and water to mix.
